text:
maya: dropping a probe: 'Metric Peek' affordance for compact compare rows. idea: ultra-minimal indicator that opens a side peek panel (no modal) with metrics + small charts. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/metric-peek
sam: I like side peek vs modal. Quick naming call: 'Peek metrics' vs 'View metrics' vs 'Inspect'?
jing: Accessibility first: whatever we name it must have a clear keyboard target and SR text. 'Peek' might be cute but unclear for assistive tech. prefer 'View metrics'.
alex: perf: lazy-load charts on open. render static sparkline svg in the row but don't mount full chart until the peek opens. use transform+opacity for reveal to avoid reflow.
len: hit-area: visually 12px dot but actual focus target 44px. aria-controls points to peek-panel-id, aria-expanded toggles when open. SR hint: 'Press Enter to open metrics panel'.
maya: microcopy poll: team picks? I'll default to 'View metrics' unless someone objects.
sam: +1 'View metrics'. Also prefer a short tooltip 'View metrics — Enter' for sighted keyboard users.
jing: contrast: small badge text currently 4.2:1. bump to #111827 or add 1px outline. For tiny dot indicator ensure contrast >=4.5:1.
alex: reduced-motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion and collapse instantly. virtualization: for catalogs >300 rows, virtualize to avoid focus jank.
QA-Bot: FYI: keyboard e2e failing on staging build. Repro: focus moves but Enter doesn't open peek. File: https://ci.example.com/job/keyboard-peek/78
maya: action items: update figma with 44px focusable affordance, add aria strings, change copy to 'View metrics', switch to transform reveal, add contrast tokens, and include exact aria text in PR. I'll push updated preview by tomorrow AM.
alex: small css stub for the team:
```css
.peek-affordance { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.peek-dot { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); }
.row:focus-within .badge, .row:hover .badge { transform: translateY(0); opacity:1; }
```
len: also spec pin behavior: pin should be per-user by default, optional 'Pin for team' in the menu requiring permissions. show small inline 'Pinned' label on pinned items.
sam: +1. And add an undo toast: 'Pinned. Undo'.
maya: thanks all 139; will iterate and ping when preview is up. :rocket:
